summary: Four new SOFT operator-experience findings scoped to this run's read_paths (facilityParameters, towerStudy, engineeringConsiderations, lightingRules + airportProximity). Engine math (§17.7 cascade, FAA chapter-code collapse, 2000 ft boundary) is sound — no engine-side findings. Earlier SSE-001..004 (executiveSummary / inputValidator / appendices / jobMonitor) are outside this run's read_paths and remain tracked in the PR-DOC cluster.

findings.title: facilityParameters prints ERP/TPO verbatim with no §73.211 class-envelope sanity note (e.g., 10 kW on Class A renders cleanly)
findings.recommended_fix: Add a class-envelope sanity check when fcc_class + erp_kw both known. If the input ERP exceeds the §73.211 class maximum (Class A: 6 kW, B1: 25 kW, B: 50 kW, C3: 25 kW, C2: 50 kW, C1: 100 kW, C0: 100 kW, C: 100 kW reference HAATs apply), prepend a soft 'ERP exceeds §73.211 max for ${class}' note in the row. Soft advisory only — engine-side §73.211 check already exists; this is operator-eye-catching surface only.
findings.reproducibility_notes: facilityParameters.js renders ERP/TPO with no class-envelope context; a typo like 10 kW on Class A renders without visible warning.

findings.title: towerStudy AGL / AMSL / ground-elevation rendered as three independent rows; no AGL + ground ≈ AMSL triangle check
findings.recommended_fix: Add an inline (|agl + ground − amsl| > 1 m) check when all three heights known. compareToAsr already uses 1 m tolerance for height; reuse the same constant. When the triangle fails, emit a SOFT 'height inputs inconsistent (|AGL + ground − AMSL| = X m, tolerance 1 m)' note adjacent to the rendered rows. Catches data-entry errors before filing.
findings.reproducibility_notes: towerStudy.js renders AGL / AMSL / ground rows but doesn't cross-check them. Pattern matches existing compareToAsr 1 m tolerance.

findings.title: engineeringConsiderations PREFACE hardcodes FM/TV vocabulary ('FCC propagation curves') even for AM exhibits where §73.184 Figure M3 groundwave applies
findings.recommended_fix: Branch the PREFACE wording on station_inputs.service: FM/FX/LPFM keeps 'FCC propagation curves per §73.333'; AM gets 'FCC groundwave field strength graphs per §73.184 (Figure M3 conductivity per §73.190)'. Same template, service-aware vocab — keeps narratives accurate for AM exhibits.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Render any AM exhibit and read the engineeringConsiderations PREFACE — currently quotes FM curves regardless of service.

findings.title: near_airport=true operator attestation silently dropped when empty airports_nearby array is also passed (array beats boolean unconditionally)
findings.recommended_fix: lightingRules.js:145-147 currently lets airports_nearby (array) win unconditionally — an empty array overrides the operator's near_airport=true attestation. Treat near_airport=true as a fallback when airports_nearby is empty (instead of replaced). Conservative behavior: if EITHER signal indicates proximity, apply the §17.4 lighting / marking review.
findings.reproducibility_notes: lightingRules.js:145-147 lets array.length check decide; empty array short-circuits before falling through to near_airport flag.
